header.name: Piotr Falkowski
header.title: Senior Backend Software Developer with over a decade of experience.

paragraphs: Driven, passionate, problem solver. I taught myself C++ to analyze financial time series using ML. Then it snowballed into .NET and countless other technologies. I’ve seen a lot, maybe even too much sometimes. I drew conclusions and now I focus on clarity, maintainability and impact.

Beyond my full-time work I develop the stock market analysis tool [Stock-Today](https://stock-today.com), I am CTO of [Squizzu](https://squizzu.com), I maintain several open source libraries and I write [False Green](https://falsegreen.dev), a blog about verification that looked green and wasn't.

stonex.title: StoneX Financial Services - Senior Software Developer
stonex.description: Migrating legacy client-facing cloud applications to a modular monolith in Domain-Driven Design and Clean Architecture. Removed the code review bottleneck in the team's SDLC and optimized DataGrid search by 10x. AI-first development with the emphasis on end-to-end and integration tests.

happyteam.title: Happy Team - Senior Software Developer
happyteam.description: Built the backend for a .NET MAUI mobile app from the ground up: a serverless API in Azure Functions talking to CosmosDb, a proxy service, and the whole supporting infrastructure described in Terraform. Designed for testability, ease of maintenance, performance and scalability.

smh.title: Seville More Helory Polska - Senior Software Developer
smh.description: Implemented, documented and unit tested GIT inspired document version control in C# ASP.NET / CosmosDb / Azure AI (Cognitive) Search + Azure Service Bus + Redis + SignalR + SonarCloud. Cut Azure Redis Cache costs by implementing an intermediate cache layer based on CosmosDb. Designed and implemented the backend for a bespoke legal Q&A, FAQ, provisions, rights and clauses lifecycle management process that secured a key client, increasing company revenue by over 10%. C# Web.API + CosmosDb + React + Service Bus.

ju.title: Jagiellonian University - Researcher
ju.description: I developed an electroencephalogram (EEG) monkey brain activity classifier and an Arduino-based tactile stimulator. The stimulator features 2 gloves with 5 effectors, each controllable separately via COM [source](https://github.com/PFalkowski/HapticStimulatorPCA9685). For classification I used Python's Keras, achieving accuracy above 0.8 after applying FFT and other transformations to raw EEG time series [source](https://github.com/PFalkowski/KerasClassifierEeg).

opengi.title: Open GI - Software Developer
opengi.description: Took part in modernizing a legacy desktop monolith by splitting and migrating logic into microservices while heavily unit-testing existing functionality, moving slowly by first hosting the old Windows application over Azure Virtual Desktop. Used ASP.NET Core, WCF, RabbitMQ, WWF, Azure IaaS, MongoDB, MS SQL, SonarQube, Docker.

transactor.title: Transactor Poland - Junior Software Developer
transactor.description: Started as a Junior Software Developer and was promoted to Regular after successfully delivering the first project — a WPF business intelligence application that aggregated data from multiple APIs, providing significant value to the customer at a low cost. C#, WPF, XSLT, XSD, SQLite, MS SQL. Developed, refactored, bug fixed, and unit tested an end-to-end insurance lifetime management system. Participated in multiple third-party integrations, including payment providers and data enrichment services, ensuring interoperability between systems. T-SQL, WCF, ASP.NET API, WPF, Windows Forms, VB.NET, MS SQL, WWF, SignalR, SOAP, Azure DevOps (VSTS at the time), Trello, Jira and Zendesk.

igexao.title: IGE+XAO - Intern
igexao.description: Implemented a database-wide undo T-SQL procedure ahead of schedule, using a C# code generator driven by the table schema. Maintained a C++ CAD desktop app.

list: 2025 - Niebezpiecznik - Attacking and Securing Web Apps
Hobbies: economics (personal finance and quantitative analysis), board games, squash, running, bodybuilding.

paragraphs: Stock market quant and fundamental analysis tool [Stock-Today](https://stock-today.com), giving daily updated insights for both speculative trading and long-term investing. Hosting: Azure, back end: C#, MS SQL, ML.NET, front end: pure HTML, CSS and JS.

I am CTO of [Squizzu](https://squizzu.com), a tech quiz platform built with React and C# leveraging generative AI. I architected and implemented most of the data model, set up CosmosDB and Key Vault integrations and I own the Azure OpenAI integration.

I write and publish [False Green](https://falsegreen.dev), a blog about verification that looked green and wasn't — each post is a real incident where a check passed while the system stayed broken. Astro static site, deployed to Azure Static Web Apps by GitHub Actions over Terraform-managed infrastructure.

I maintain a public set of [Claude Code skills](https://github.com/PFalkowski/skills) — over 30 repeatable workflows for code review, triage, handoff and release hygiene, installable as a Claude Code plugin.

Throughout my journey I have also explored other startup ventures, including an online course platform and a calendar tool built with Power Apps. While these projects didn't achieve long-term success, they provided valuable lessons and skills such as proficiency in the Power Platform.
